title: nbn network maintenance affecting some nbn services
current_summary:
The maintenance window is 1:00am to 7:00am AEDT on 9 December 2026. A loss of connectivity of around 3 hours is expected, starting at 1:00am AEDT. 18 of our nbn services are affected.

nbn® is working hard to resolve a network issue in your area. This emergency work will cause a temporary loss of connectivity to your nbn service.
Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected if needed. Check the nbn Network Outages website periodically for the latest updates.

cause.reason: Planned network maintenance on the nbn access network
